h1: Salon and nail salon management software for Europe
intro: Bookings, checkout, EET, staff pay, tips and regular clients: what salon management software should do, and how SalonGo does it.

body: Salon management software puts the salon's daily work in one place: taking bookings, scheduling staff, checkout, client records, revenue and payroll. Instead of a paper diary, spreadsheets and scattered messages, the owner opens the app and sees who is doing what today and how much came in.
SalonGo is salon management software made for Vietnamese-run nail, hair, lash and beauty salons in Europe. It runs in the browser on phones, iPads and computers, with apps for Mac and Windows.

sections.h: What should nail salon software do?
body: Nail salons have several technicians, many short services, lots of regulars and tips. Good nail salon software should:
points: Give the salon its own online booking page where clients pick a service, a technician and a free time
Show a calendar per technician, so you see at a glance who is free
Take payments at the desk by cash, card or bank transfer and record tips
Calculate pay automatically as a percentage of revenue or a fixed salary, with tips shared the way the owner chooses
Report revenue by day, by technician and by service

body: Each salon gets its own booking link for Facebook, Instagram or Google Maps. Clients book in Czech, Slovak, German, English or French, while the owner confirms and assigns staff in one box.
The booking page only shows times when staff are free, so there are no double bookings. Clients with an email get a confirmation and a reminder 1 hour before.
sections.figure: The salon's online booking page: the client picks a day and a free time

body: Pick the service, the staff member and how the client pays, and the receipt is done. Every payment goes straight into your revenue reports:
points: Cash, card or bank transfer by QR code with the amount filled in, so the till matches at closing
Every payment creates a receipt, printed at 80 mm and easy to find later
Tips are recorded on the receipt and shared the way the owner chooses

sections.h: EET 2.0 from 1 January 2027: what salons need
body: From 1 January 2027, every cash or card payment in Czechia must be reported to the tax office. With SalonGo you don't need a separate till or extra software.

Upload the certificate from the DIS+ portal and enter the password and the shop ID in the app. From then on every receipt is sent to EET and printed with its FIK code. EET is in every plan, including the Chair plan, at no extra cost.

sections.h: Salon income and expenses: know your profit
body: The income tab adds up revenue from receipts by itself. The expenses tab records stock, rent and the like: amount, date, payment method and a short note. Income minus expenses shows straight away for each location, and you can export it to CSV, Excel or PDF for your accountant.
sections.figure: Income and expenses in SalonGo: income from receipts and salon expenses

sections.h: Clear staff pay and tip sharing
body: Each staff member has one pay type: a percentage of their own revenue (optionally per service) or a fixed monthly salary. The owner chooses whether each tip goes to the person the client tipped or all tips are split equally. At month end, open payroll and export.

sections.h: Keep regulars coming back with email marketing
body: Clients has 10 occasion templates such as Christmas, New Year, Valentine's Day, Women's Day, Mother's Day and Black Friday. Edit a few lines, add a discount, preview and send to clients who agreed to offers. The app also flags client birthdays 2 days ahead so you can send wishes with an offer.

sections.h: Multiple locations, staff schedule on the phone
body: One owner account runs every location, switches between them from the menu and sees all locations' revenue on one page. Staff have their own login on the phone and see their own appointments and, if the owner allows it, their own revenue.

Every plan has every feature; plans differ only by staff per location and number of locations: Basic {priceBasic} CZK/month ({staffBasic} staff, 1 location), Pro {pricePro} CZK/month ({staffPro} staff per location, up to {branchesPro} locations) and Premium {pricePremium} CZK/month ({premiumLimits}).[[discount: Paying yearly saves {discount}%.]] New salons get a free {days}-day trial, no card needed.
Chair renters with their own IČO use the Chair plan, {priceDesk} CZK/month. Plans are bought and renewed in the browser; the iPhone app does not sell plans.

sections.h: Up and running in an afternoon
body: No technical skills or complicated setup needed:
steps: Create a free account, enter the salon name and opening hours
Add staff, services, prices and how you pay staff
Share your booking link on Facebook, Instagram and Google
Stuck? Support answers in Vietnamese and Czech

faq.q: Is there one app for appointments, checkout and staff payroll?
faq.a: Yes. SalonGo does all of it: clients book online through your salon's own link, the calendar is split by staff member, checkout records payment and tips with a receipt, and payroll is calculated at month end (percentage or fixed salary). It works on phone, tablet and computer, with a {days}-day free trial.
